The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The strategy of extracting the HWPX (ZIP), performing regex-based XML replacement, and stripping layout cache elements (`<hp:lineSegArray>`) to prevent rendering artifacts worked perfectly. 

One specific technical detail to note for future HWPX tasks: Word processor XML often splits placeholders across tags (e.g., `{{` in one tag and `name}}` in another). While this specific run succeeded with simple string replacement on the full XML text, more robust solutions should consider joining adjacent text elements within a paragraph before matching, or using a regex that allows for intervening XML tags between characters of the placeholder.
